source_full_text: But first you must be rewarded for all your kind services to my children. Follow me down into the inner cellar, where you have never yet been, For I always keep it locked and carry the key away with me Lizina looked round her in astonishment as they went down into the great vaulted cellar underneath the kitchen.

reference_text: 但首先，你必须因对我孩子们所做的一切善行而得到奖赏。跟我来，下到内侧的地窖去，那里你从未去过，因为我总是把门锁上，并把钥匙随身带走。莉齐娜跟着往下走时，惊讶地环顾四周，那是厨房下面巨大的拱顶地窖。
